T1158.long: To prevent normal users from accidentally changing special files on a system, most operating systems have the concept of a ‘hidden’ file. These files don’t show up when a user browses the file system with a GUI or when using normal commands on the command line. Users must explicitly ask to show the hidden files either via a series of Graphical User Interface (GUI) prompts or with command line switches (dir /a for Windows and ls –a for Linux and macOS).

strings: Hi Dave, Who was the organisation you said to get in contact with through regional office?
re good, are you free anytime today for a chat?
m in a workshop all day today if a get the chance I will call you if not can I call at 1pm tomorrow?
Sorry mate, just noticed I missed your call, phone on silent, sorry
s email address Darren.hall@Unite the union.org
d like to know, I received a response from the pension trustees secretary letting me know my appeal for I
ll Health Early Retirement has been successful
ur daughter Tim hoping she makes a full and speedy recovery.
She looks to have made a good physical recovery, need to keep her mental recovery going. Hence why I

ve applied for a postponement on the tribunal so I can g take JLR down the ombudsman root. Remember when you said, in the final capability study meeting, someone needs to be held accountable? Well, take a look at the root, I hope, the ombudsman chooses to take: https://www.pensions-ombudsman.org.uk/news-item/tpo-launches-pensions-dishonesty-unit
t copied Emma in on the emails, not that I didn
t want her to know, just that I can text you on union matters without you being under obligation to tell JLR, did want to put her in that situation, not that JLR don
t know about the application for a postponement, I CCed JLR
s Employment Litigation team on the email to MidlandsWestET along with Darren and Teresa
The Union has stitched me up BIG TIME
re doing well?  Just wondering if you can send me a copy of your note taken during my capability review for my IHER with Emma and Dan
m not in the office at the moment. Current estimate for return is mid October my notes are all stored in a cabinet in the office.
m ok just had some heart issues and waiting on a procedure to rectify but I
m going ok. Just managed to convince them I am ok to work but they have limited it to from home for now.  Hope you are doing ok
Take it from someone who has experienced heart problems in 2006 & 2020, don
t push it mate, your health is much more important, don
t run yourself into the ground there
s more to life than work!!!  October will be a little too late for what it
t affect the outcome, just provide cherry on top, but I still would like a copy mate.
m on a steep learning curve at the moment but I am taking it steady.
ve been able to access the notes yet? Would be very very useful for a submission to Action Fraud I
m in the process of submitting.
Hi Tim, hope you are doing well.  Not much has changed for me, my phased return got extended honestly I don
